text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- State-owned airline Royal Air Maroc bids to purchase struggling French Air Liberte.
- Justice Minister Abderrahman Amalou meets magistrates bound for France where they will train in order to run trade courts in Morocco as part of agreement between the two countries.
- Gas pipeline to link North Africa to Europe to start operating in few weeks.
- Agriculture Minister Hassan Abouayoub says agriculture is an essential part of association in the Mediterranean basin.
- Jalal Essaid re-elected as president of parliament.
